description: Portable, repository-local Codex context and command safeguards.

hooks.commandWindows: $payload=[Console]::In.ReadToEnd(); $data=$null; try { $data=$payload | ConvertFrom-Json } catch {}; $start=if ($data -and $data.cwd) { [string]$data.cwd } else { (Get-Location).Path }; $root=(& git -C $start rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>$null); if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0 -or -not $root) { exit 0 }; $payload | & powershell.exe -NoProfile -NonInteractive -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File (Join-Path ([string]$root.Trim()) '.agent/hooks.ps1') session-start; exit $LASTEXITCODE

hooks.command: r=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null) || exit 0; AGENT_STOP_GATE_ENABLED=1 bash "$r/.agent/stop-verify.sh" session-start
